mapper.sql: SELECT AC.OUTLAY AS OUTLAY, AC.PAYMENT_TIME FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT SUM(T.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, T.PAYMENT_TIME, T.X_AXIS FROM (SELECT ROUND(IFNULL(AC.OUTLAY, 0) / CASE
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID) END , 2) AS OUTLAY, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAYMENT_TIME, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS X_AXIS FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCostDto.tenantId}
AND AC.USER_ID = #{accountCostDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= #{accountCostDto.paymentTimeFrom} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME <= #{accountCostDto.paymentTimeTo} GROUP BY AC.ID
UNION ALL
SELECT ROUND(IFNULL(AC.OUTLAY, 0) / CASE
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID) END , 2) AS OUTLAY, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAYMENT_TIME, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS X_AXIS FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCostDto.tenantId}
AND ACU.USER_ID = #{accountCostDto.userId} AND AC.USER_ID <> #{accountCostDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= #{accountCostDto.paymentTimeFrom} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME <= #{accountCostDto.paymentTimeTo} GROUP BY AC.ID) T GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(T.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT T.COST_TYPE, T.COST_DESC, SUM(T.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, T.DATE_SIGN, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T.DATE_SIGN DESC ) AS RK FROM (SELECT AC.COST_TYPE, AC.COST_DESC, CONCAT(year(AC.PAYMENT_TIME), 'WK', LPAD(WEEK(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, 1), 2, '0')) as DATE_SIGN, ROUND(IFNULL(AC.OUTLAY, 0) / CASE
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID) END , 2) AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCost.tenantId}
AND AC.USER_ID = #{accountCost.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL 3 WEEK) GROUP BY AC.COST_TYPE, AC.PAYMENT_TIME
UNION ALL
SELECT AC.COST_TYPE, AC.COST_DESC, CONCAT(year(AC.PAYMENT_TIME), 'WK', LPAD(WEEK(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, 1), 2, '0')) as DATE_SIGN, ROUND(IFNULL(AC.OUTLAY, 0) / CASE
WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID) END , 2) AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCost.tenantId}
AND ACU.USER_ID = #{accountCost.userId} AND AC.USER_ID <> #{accountCost.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL 3 WEEK) GROUP BY AC.COST_TYPE, AC.PAYMENT_TIME) T GROUP BY T.COST_TYPE, T.DATE_SIGN ORDER BY T.DATE_SIGN DESC, T.OUTLAY DESC

SELECT T.COST_TYPE, T.COST_DESC, SUM(T.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, T.DATE_SIGN, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T.DATE_SIGN DESC ) AS RK FROM (SELECT AC.COST_TYPE, AC.COST_DESC, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%y%m') AS DATE_SIGN, ROUND(IFNULL(AC.OUTLAY, 0) / IFNULL(NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID), 0), 1) , 2) AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCost.tenantId}
AND AC.USER_ID = #{accountCost.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB( DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL 3 MONTH ) GROUP BY AC.COST_TYPE, AC.PAYMENT_TIME
UNION ALL
SELECT AC.COST_TYPE, AC.COST_DESC, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%y%m') AS DATE_SIGN, ROUND(IFNULL(AC.OUTLAY, 0) / IFNULL(NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_cost_user ACU WHERE 1 = 1 AND ACU.COST_ID = AC.ID), 0), 1) , 2) AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCost.tenantId}
AND ACU.USER_ID = #{accountCost.userId} AND AC.USER_ID <> #{accountCost.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB( DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY AC.COST_TYPE, AC.PAYMENT_TIME) T GROUP BY T.COST_TYPE, T.DATE_SIGN ORDER BY T.DATE_SIGN DESC, T.OUTLAY DESC
